race.comment: UNIFIES (2) was well fancied on the back of a couple of minor placings but could only manage fifth last start over 1000m at Bowen. Worth noting Mark Du Plessis is the change of rider. Has good early speed so should take up a forward position and rates a leading contender. SENSEI GIRL (5) proved too strong last start and scored by a head over 950m at this track. Has a solid record at this course and distance, including a win and two placings. Will prove tough to beat. SILVERTURN (8) finished fourth over 1100m at Innisfail when resuming last start, beaten only 1.4 lengths. Goes up a rung or two but she is fitter and up to the task. BABUSHKA MISS (3) was thereabouts at the latest effort when fourth over 950m at this circuit after being in contention on the turn. Likely improver with strong top-three prospects.
